Subject. Anonymous letter against C.D.S. 281 - statement taken.

Made by C.D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by: D. S. I. Logan.

With reference to the remarks of the
D.C. (Special Branch) on the attached report
regarding an anonymous letter containing allegations

statement made by the detective in question is
attached hereto, together with an agreement with the
lease in respect of Room No. 12 2nd floor, Coal
Merchants' Guild Building, 405 Tientsin Road, of
which the detective is the chief tenant and
has let it to a third party.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 321 21/ 8 /40）

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Ling Zung Foo (林自甫).
native of ............................................................ taken by My Self
at Police Hdqrs. on the 21/8/40 translated and interpreted by Clerk Chin Ching Hai.

My name is Ling Zung Foo. I am C.D.S. 281
attached to Special Branch, Headquarters, S.M.P.
Prior to the outbreak of the current Sino-
Japanese hostilities, I lived in Lane 946, 23 Chemilpo
Road, together with my family. Following the outbreak
of hostilities, my family took refuge in Huchow and
came back to Shanghai on July 15, 1938. We took up
lodging in the North Station Lodging House (北站大旅社)
Boundary Road, because my household effects in the
former home were all stolen.
In April, 1939, we removed to room No.11,
2nd floor of the Coal Merchants' Guild Building, 605
Tientsin Road, at a monthly rental of $35.00. About
one month later, I was told by one Mr. Kwan of the
Rent Agent's Office of the Building, that the occupant
of Room No.12 which is opposite to my room, did not
pay his rent for four months and refused to get out.
I negotiated with the occupant of that room. He
agreed to remove when I would pay the four months'
rent in arrears and gave him a sum of $250.00 as removal
expenses. I then told Mr. Kwan and Mr. Zung (陳),
another employee of the Rent Agent, about the matter and
completed all the procedure for the handing over of the
lease of the room to me and provided a guarantee bond.
I spent a further $500 as "Siao Fee" (小費) in securing
the lease, thus making a total of $750 expended.
On May 1, 1939, I removed to live in Room 12.

以下为林自甫（Ling Zung Foo）的供词。
籍贯 ............................................................ 由本人于1940年8月21日在警察总局录取，由书记员陈青海翻译及传译。

我叫林自甫。我是上海公共租界工部局警务处总部特别股的华探员，编号281。
在当前中日敌对行动爆发之前，我与家人居住在乍浦路23号946弄。敌对行动爆发后，我的家人避难至湖州，并于1938年7月15日返回上海。由于原住所的家当全部被盗，我们在边界路北站大旅社暂住。
1939年4月，我们搬至天津路605号煤业公会大楼二楼11号房间，月租金为35.00美元。大约一个月后，大楼租赁代理处的关先生告诉我，我对面12号房间的租客已拖欠四个月租金并拒绝搬离。我与该房间 occupant（住客）进行了协商。他同意在我支付四个月欠租并给予他250.00美元作为搬迁费后搬走。随后我将此事告知关先生及租赁代理处的另一名雇员陈先生，并完成了将房间租赁权移交给我的所有手续，还提供了担保书。为了获得租赁权，我又花费了500美元作为“小费”，总计支出750美元。
1939年5月1日，我搬入12号房间居住。

Translation of Lease Agreement

This is to certify that Foo Teung Ling
(富春霖) has rented the whole of Room
No. 12, 2nd floor, Coal Merchants' Guild
Building, from Mr. Ling. The rental is $70
per month, to be paid in advance monthly. The
rent excludes electricity charges but includes
water charges and municipal rate. The guarantor
will be solely responsible for non-payment of
rents and will pay the rents in arrears on
behalf of the lessee. This agreement is signed
for future reference and will be observed by
both parties. The following are the terms of
the agreement :-

1. It is agreed by both parties that the
lessor cannot request the lessee to
remove within one year, but the latter
will be permitted to remove if he has
occupied the room for more than 5 months.

2. The lessee is not permitted to store
contraband in the room or to conduct
any unlawful activities. In case of
such being committed, the guarantor
will be held solely responsible.

3. That a deposit equivalent to 2 months'
rent ($140) be paid on the signing of the
agreement, which will be refunded when
the lessee vacates the room.

Original
lodged & C.D.S
SCl on 12-10-40.
Li

Lessee : Foo Teung Ling
Guarantor: Tien Shang Theatre.

Date : 8/11/39.
page_data.zh:
租赁协议译文

兹证明富春霖（Foo Teung Ling）已向林先生租用煤业公会大楼二楼12号房间全间。租金为每月70美元，须按月预付。租金不含电费，但包含水费及市政捐税。担保人将对欠租承担全部责任，并代表承租人支付拖欠租金。本协议签署以备查考，双方均须遵守。协议条款如下：-

1. 双方同意，出租人不得在一年内要求承租人搬离，但若承租人已居住超过5个月，则允许其搬离。

2. 承租人不得在房间内储存违禁品或进行任何非法活动。如有此类行为发生，担保人将承担全部责任。

3. 签署协议时需支付相当于两个月租金（140美元）的押金，待承租人退租时将予以退还。

原件
已存档 & 华探员编号
SCl 于 1940年10月12日。
Li

承租人：富春霖
担保人：天上戏院。

CRIME REPORT
to attend al money letter.
C.D.I. Shih Tao Liang.
Discreet enquiry by C.D.C. 341 shows that
405 Tientsin Road is the Coal Merchants Guild
Building, and Room 12, 2nd floor which is situated
at the end of the corridor, some 15 yards
from the main staircase, has a space of about
12' X 3'.
The present occupants of the room are the
players and members of the management of the Tien
Shang Theatre (Shaoshing Play), situated at east
wing of downstairs room at 405 Tientsin Road who
are using it as a recreation rendezvous, usually
after the performance in the evening, at 12 m.m.
It has been ascertained that Mah Jong is the game
usually resorted to by the inmates, but when there
are sufficient number of persons present, gambling
of other sorts such as "Yao Tai" is also indulged in.
This usually takes place at the beginning of every
month when all persons have received their wages.
Participants at these games are however confined
to players and members of the management of the
Tien Shang Theatre and sometimes occupants of
other rooms in the same building.
DC (S.B)
Information
(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE AHO-TOTEMO)
Shih Tao Liang

犯罪报告
关于处理匿名信事宜。
华探长施道良。
经华巡长编号341秘密调查，显示
天津路405号为煤业公会大楼，二楼12号房间位于走廊尽头，距主楼梯约15码，面积约为12英尺 X 3英尺。
该房间目前的住客是位于天津路405号楼下东翼的天上戏院（绍剧）的演员及管理人员，他们通常将其作为娱乐聚会场所，一般在晚上演出结束后，即午夜12点左右使用。经查实，住客通常进行的游戏是麻将，但当人数足够时，也会进行其他类型的赌博，如“摇摊”。这通常发生在每月初，即所有人领到薪水的时候。然而，参与这些游戏的人仅限于天上戏院的演员和管理人员，有时也包括同一栋大楼其他房间的住客。

AUG 8.
RECEIVED

Police detective: Allegations against.

Ling Zeng-fu (浦臣林), a detective of the Shanghai
Municipal Police, is an unscrupulous man. Last year he used his
influence at the Police Stations to open an opium den in Room 12,
2nd floor of No.405 Tientsin Road. Now the place is provided
with two tables for gambling, and he collects commission from the
gamblers. He also lends money at usurious interest at No.95
Wuchang Road. Please order Ling to stop his unlawful activities.
(Signed) A Victim.

(Note: Received for translation late p.m. 7th August, 1940).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL AUG 8 1940 TRANSLATION OFFICE）
